purpose: Teach: 旦那/友だち/僕たち/中華/居酒屋/あいさつ/さっそく/金曜日

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、旦那、絶対、さん、絶対、優しいよね
lines.en: Riku — your grandpa is seriously so kind, you know?
lines.style: Bright, direct, affectionate teasing. Quick attack. Natural conversational rhythm, like she's stating something obvious to someone she's close to.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前は、本気で、絶対、クラスの、絶対、友だち、絶対、多いよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. And you're seriously everyone's friend in our class, aren't you?
lines.style: Gentle deflection with a compliment underneath. Measured pace. The tone of someone turning attention away from himself and toward her — warm but a little uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、本気で、絶対、僕たち、絶対、出し物、絶対、頑張ろうね、リク
lines.en: For the culture festival, let's really make our exhibit amazing, okay, Riku?
lines.style: Forward-looking energy, rallying tone. Slight rise on the closing 'okay' — inviting him in. Genuine enthusiasm without being over-performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の、本気で、絶対、中華、絶対、屋さん、絶対、美味かったよな、桜
lines.en: That Chinese place by the station was really good, wasn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm nostalgia in the voice. A little brighter than usual — remembering something good. Conversational, not distant, but with a hint of him testing whether she remembers it the same way.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いつか、本気で、絶対、私たち、絶対、大きくなったら、絶対、居酒屋、絶対、行ってみたいな、リク
lines.en: Someday when we're older, I really want to go to an izakaya with you, Riku.
lines.style: Soft, imagining tone. Slower pace. A small vulnerability underneath — she's saying something that matters. Trailing slightly on the ending, like she's not sure how he'll take it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、先生への、絶対、あいさつ、絶対、しっかりしてるよな、桜
lines.en: You're really serious about greeting the teacher properly, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Noticing and approving. Quiet observation without lecture. Warmer than teasing — genuine respect in the tone. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、さっそく、絶対、新作の漫画、絶対、読んだの?リク
lines.en: Did you already read that new manga yet, Riku?
lines.style: Quick, curious, eager for his answer. Natural question rhythm — not staged. A little hopeful underneath, like she wants to talk about it with him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今度の、本気で、絶対、金曜日、絶対、お前と、絶対、お祭り、絶対、行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: Let's go to the festival next Friday together, okay?
lines.style: Direct invite with warmth underneath. Gentle but certain. Not asking permission — offering something. Slight lift at the very end, hopeful without being needy.
